title: Metadata
description: Shared metadata for parts (SKU schemas) and inventory items. The shape is fixed: every field is required, and a field left out on create gets its "default". Null or empty values are not displayed. Unknown fields are rejected.

category.description: Category tags; null or empty is not displayed.

image_urls.description: Image URLs shown in order by the UI carousel; null or empty hides the carousel.

specification.description: Free-form specification table: any spec name mapped to a string value, like a product spec sheet. Empty is not displayed.
